images.title: An angle covered by a 1/6 piece and a 1/12 piece
images.purpose: Show an angle measured by laying a 1/6 piece and a 1/12 piece side by side from the first line, and how their fractions add to 1/4, a right angle.
images.composition: An angle with two coloured pieces laid on it on the left and the adding written on the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. ANGLE, corner point (300, 640) shown as a dark dot 26 px across. The first line is a teal #0072B2 line (10 px, 460 px long) going right from the corner along y 640. The second line is a reddish purple #CC79A7 line (10 px, 460 px long) going straight up from the corner (so the angle is a quarter turn), with a small square corner mark (40 by 40 px, thin dark outline) at the corner. Two wedge pieces of radius 420 px are laid side by side inside the angle with their points on the corner: the first, a 1/6 piece (a sector that is one sixth of a circle), filled teal #0072B2 at 55 percent opacity, starts on the first line and goes up to the left of the right end; the second, a 1/12 piece (a sector that is half as wide as the first), filled amber #E69F00 at 55 percent opacity, sits next to the first and ends exactly on the second line. Each piece has a thin dark outline and its fraction written inside near the rim in dark bold sans-serif (40 px): 1/6 on the first and 1/12 on the second. A red #D55E00 arc (4 px, radius 100 px) marks the whole angle. RIGHT SIDE: four lines of dark bold text (46 px) left aligned at x 900: 1/6 + 1/12 at y 250, = 2/12 + 1/12 at y 330, = 3/12 = 1/4 at y 410, and right angle at y 500 in teal #0072B2 (54 px). Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a 1/6 piece and a 1/12 piece of the same width
more or fewer than 2 pieces on the angle
images.takeaway: A 1/6 piece and a 1/12 piece side by side make 3/12 = 1/4 of a turn: a right angle.
images.description: A right angle covered by a 1/6 piece and a 1/12 piece laid side by side, with 1/6 + 1/12 = 2/12 + 1/12 = 3/12 = 1/4 written beside it.
images.context: Concept image for Measuring an Angle. It follows the idea of the angle measuring tools in your maths book (pieces cut from the tracing-paper circles) and shows the concept's own example of a 1/6 piece and a 1/12 piece.
images.teaching_notes: Lay the 1/12 piece on the 1/6 piece first to see that 1/6 is two of them. The slip to watch is adding the 6 and the 12 to get 1/18.

image_decisions.why: The two pieces laid side by side on the right angle show how the fractions of the pieces add to the turn of the angle.
